notes: Settings is less cluttered: each account and category row now has a single 'edit' that opens an inline form with every setting (account: name, type, bank, last 4, login, statement format, off budget, forget mapping; category: name, group, expense/income, tax-deductible checkbox). Plus 1.13.0: Balances tab works on the phone as cards; Accounts cards show last import and last balance check (amber when overdue); Budget page month-close checklist with a green line once a past month is done.
